maturityControls.description: An authoritative catalog of data sources, schemas, and assigned data owners exists.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Cl. 6.1.2 & Annex A.6
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Ensure all newly connected vector databases and CRM replicas register an active data owner.

maturityControls.description: Data sets are tagged with sensitivity levels (Public/Internal/Confidential/Restricted) and purpose limitations.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Cl. 8.2 & GDPR Art. 5(1)(b)
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Verify that DLP checks enforce classification tags at the prompt injection stage.

maturityControls.description: Provenance, content hash, transformation history, and freshness timestamps are tracked.
maturityControls.isoReference: DAMA-DMBOK Ch. 13 & NIST AI RMF Map 1.5
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Reject RAG chunks whose freshness exceeds SLA without human escalation.

maturityControls.description: Data retention periods, quality scoring metrics, and safe disposal policies are enforced.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. A.6.3 & GDPR Art. 5(1)(e)
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Automate weekly purging of intermediate scratch embeddings beyond the 90-day window.

maturityControls.description: Agents use dedicated technical service identities, never inheriting raw end-user credentials.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. A.7.2 & NIST AI RMF Govern 1.2
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Audit token issuance to guarantee agents cannot impersonate human executives.

maturityControls.description: Permissions are scoped per task, resource, and time window with automatic credential rotation.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. A.7.3 & Zero Trust Architecture
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Configure token TTL to a maximum of 24 hours for autonomous background workers.

maturityControls.description: Tool executions route through a gateway that checks schemas, whitelists, and rate limits.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. A.8.4 & OWASP Top 10 for LLM
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Block direct external HTTP sockets from inside LLM execution containers.

maturityControls.description: Irreversible or high-consequence operations require human approval outside the model.
maturityControls.isoReference: EU AI Act Art. 14 & ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. A.9.4
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Enforce two-person dual authorization for transactions exceeding $10,000.

maturityControls.description: Prompts, grounded source references, model versions, and response metadata are recorded.
maturityControls.isoReference: EU AI Act Art. 12 & ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. 9.1
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Store cryptographic hashes of reference materials alongside generated text.

maturityControls.description: All tool calls, arguments, status codes, and reversal payloads are logged.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. A.9.2
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Ensure structured JSON parameters are preserved in execution logs.

maturityControls.description: Audit logs have restricted access, defined retention, and automated PII/secret scrubbing.
maturityControls.isoReference: GDPR Art. 32 & ISO/IEC 27001 Cl. A.12.4
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Run DLP regex filter on audit output before writing to immutable storage.

maturityControls.description: Every interaction carries a unique correlation ID to rebuild the entire decision chain.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. 9.2 & NIST AI RMF Manage 2.4
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Validate that correlation IDs span across source retrieval, LLM call, and tool execution.

maturityControls.description: Each AI system has a named business process owner and a technical platform owner.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. 5.3
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Review ownership roster during quarterly AI governance board meetings.

maturityControls.description: Formal risk assessments (impact, reversibility, bias, safety) are conducted prior to production.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. 6.1.2 & EU AI Act Art. 9
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Standardize adversarial red-teaming checklist for all customer-facing agents.

maturityControls.description: End users are notified of AI interaction and provided clear human escalation pathways.
maturityControls.isoReference: EU AI Act Art. 50 & ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. 7.4
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Display prominent disclaimers and immediate fallback button in chat widgets.

maturityControls.description: Documented playbook for AI anomalies, automated rollback, and rapid containment.
maturityControls.isoReference: NIST AI RMF Manage 3.1 & ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. 10.1
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Test the 1-click Agent Kill Switch monthly with simulated rogue tool requests.

maturityControls.description: Continuous benchmarking against golden datasets to detect performance drift.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. 9.1 & NIST AI RMF Measure 2.1
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Run weekly automated evaluation of retrieval precision against legal policies.

maturityControls.description: Telemetry captures tool failure spikes, refusal rates, and latency anomalies.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. 9.1
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Alert on-call engineers if tool rejection rate exceeds 5% in a 15-minute window.

maturityControls.description: Periodic re-certification of agent scopes and database connection credentials.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. A.7.4
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Automate 90-day scope expiration prompting system owners to re-authorize.

maturityControls.description: Formal checklist for retiring models: revoking keys, purging memory, archiving logs.
maturityControls.isoReference: ISO/IEC 42001 Cl. A.8.5 & GDPR Right to be Forgotten
maturityControls.remediationGuidance: Verify that retired agent API keys immediately yield HTTP 403 Forbidden.
